metadata.remarks: Profile for one believable small business: a Fort Lauderdale firm that needs a client portal (CMS) with PII redaction, attributable actions, least privilege, retention, and anchored integrity. All five catalog controls included, plus a two-approval tailoring on etched-ac-1.
metadata.title: Small regulated business client-portal profile

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Tailoring: root-level portal actions (key rotation, grant changes, anchor submission) require two approvals: the owner and the policy co-signer (the control-plane chatbot, which approves by written policy only and never executes). Out-of-policy requests are refused; only an audited break-glass override proceeds. A designated human second approver replaces the co-signer later. Enforced by the policy engine; counted on the same surface that requested them.
parts.title: Two-approval rule for root actions
